''Carex hudsonii'' A.Benn.{{Cite web |url = http://www.habitas.org.uk/flora/species.asp?item=2457 |title = Flora of Northern Ireland |accessdate = 2007-12-31 |date = 2000–2004 |work = Vascular Plant Database for Northern Ireland |publisher = National Museums and Galleries of Northern Ireland and Environment and Heritage Service}} }} }} [[Image:Cleaned-Illustration Carex acuta.jpg|thumb|124px|Illustration of ''Carex acuta'']] '''''Carex acuta''''' (common names '''acute sedge''', '''slender tufted-sedge''', or '''slim sedge)''' is a perennial, tussock-forming plant in the ''Carex'', or sedge family. == Description == ''Carex acuta'' is a tuft-forming, slender, rhizomatous plant with narrow, flat leaves reaching up to 90 cm in height. Stems are three-angled. Inflorescence is a spike, with brown flowers appearing in late spring and summer.{{Cite web |title=Carex acuta {{!}} slender-tufted sedge Herbaceous Perennial/RHS |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/139088/carex-acuta/details |access-date=2025-02-25 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}{{Cite web |title=Slender Tufted-sedge {{!}} NatureSpot |url=https://www.naturespot.org/species/slender-tufted-sedge |access-date=2025-02-25 |website=www.naturespot.org}} == Distribution and habitat == It can be found growing on the margins of [[river]]s and [[lake]]s in the [[Palearctic realm|Palaearctic]] [[terrestrial ecoregions]] in beds of wet, [[Alkaline#Alkaline soil|alkaline]] or [[Alkaline soil|slightly acid]] [[Depression (geology)|depression]]s with [[mineral]] [[soil]]. ''Carex acuta'' does not tolerate prolonged [[desiccation]]. The community is distributed, in particular, in northern [[France]], [[Low Countries|the Low Countries]], [[Central Europe]] south to the [[Sava]] and [[Drava]] [[Geography of Croatia|valleys of Croatia]], the northern [[Great Morava|Morava]] valley of [[Geography of Serbia|Serbia]] and [[Geography of Romania|Romania]], north to [[Geography of Poland|Poland]], the [[Kaliningrad Oblast|Kaliningrad District]], [[Geography of Lithuania|Lithuania]] and [[Latvia]], in southern [[Scandinavia#Usage in geography|Scandinavia]], in the [[Dnieper basin]] of northern [[Geography of Ukraine|Ukraine]] and southern [[Belarus#Geography|Belarus]], in the lower [[Volga River|Volga]] Valley.{{Cite web | url = http://eunis.eea.europa.eu/habitats-factsheet.jsp?idHabitat=5131 | title = Factsheet for Slender tufted sedge beds | accessdate = 2007-12-31 | last = European Environment Agency (EEA) | first = Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. and Vander Linden, C. | authorlink = European Environment Agency | year = 2001 | work = EUNIS biodiversity database }} {{clear|left}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{Commons category-inline|Carex acuta|''Carex acuta''}} *{{Cite web | url = http://jncc.gov.uk/page-3257-type=speciesList-theme=textonly-p=30-filter=AnalysisID=21 AND DatasetID=31 | title = Observations of Slender Tufted-sedge Carex acuta | accessdate = 2011-04-06 | author = Joint Nature Conservation Committee | authorlink = Joint Nature Conservation Committee | date = 1958–1998 | work = Wildlife Statistics Online }}{{Dead link|date=June 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} {{Taxonbar|from=Q157908}} [[Category:Carex|acuta]] [[Category:Flora of Asia]] [[Category:Flora of Europe]] [[Category:Flora of North Africa]] [[Category:Plants described in 1753]] [[Category:Botanical taxa named by Carl Linnaeus]] [[Category:Grasses of Lebanon]] {{Carex-stub}}
